name: inventory-management-system
description: Termux-compatible Inventory Management System — React + Express + sql.js

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend --no-optional --omit=optional && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.lint:sh: shellcheck -x -s bash START.sh STOP.sh RUN.sh scripts/*.sh
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm test && npm run test:frontend && npm run i18n:check && npm run build
